feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 June 2026 10:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 18 June 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland and high pressure over continental Europe, with frontal zones affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, but 2 to 4 in the southeast of the area, becoming 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, occasionally rough in the west tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle, with areas of mist and isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain/drizzle/mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 to 5, veering west or southwest 2 to 4 Saturday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle with areas of mist and isolated fog patches, becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain/drizzle/mist and very poor in fog patches.
